counting_assumptions: Reported and passed floors are calibrated to the macOS SwiftPM lane with Swift 6.3.1, CI=true, and Swift Testing xUnit output; review them when that toolchain or lane changes.
The source floor is a lexical inventory of @Test declarations in every Swift file under Tests/SwiftVLCTests, including declarations behind platform conditionals; it is not an executed-test count.

The uncontracted skip ceiling excludes only the exact, mutually exclusive native-version identities below while CI transitions from the released extension-version-7 artifact to the rebuilt extension-version-8 artifact. The four version-8 scenarios receive allowances only before the upgrade; the reciprocal pre-version-8 rejection scenario receives its allowance only after the upgrade, preserving the same general skip-debt ceiling on either artifact.
